keyed.HH.Setting.venues.browseTicks.Desc: How long a guest looks at an item before deciding. 60 ticks is one second at normal speed.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.dayOpen.Desc: Hour the 'Day' preset in the sign's hours dialog opens.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.drinkGapHours.Desc: A guest does not order another drink before this many hours have passed.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.eveningClose.Desc: Hour the 'Evening' preset closes (an earlier hour than opening means after midnight).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.hideVanilla.Desc: When a Hearth & Harbor building replaces a vanilla one (for example the card table for the poker table), the vanilla one disappears from the build menu once the replacement is available. Buildings you already placed stay. Takes effect after a restart or the next game load.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.lastOrdersMinutes.Desc: In this last stretch before closing time guests in a hurry buy one more round, no guest starts a long browse and a purchase already under way is still served after closing. 0 = no last orders.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketCaravans.Desc: How many trader caravans come on market day (fewer if few factions are friendly).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketDays.Desc: Average interval of the big market, with a little randomness.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketEnabled.Desc: Every so often friendly factions bring several trader caravans and day visitors at once. Only happens while you run at least one shop.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketRenown.Desc: Minimum renown (0-100) before traders and visitors want to hold a market with you. Without a renown system the colony counts as neutral (50).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketStalls.Desc: The big market only happens once you own this many free-standing market stalls (traders set up at them). With fewer stalls fewer caravans come.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketVisitors.Desc: How many groups of day visitors come on market day, to shop in your venues.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.maxPurchases.Desc: A guest stops shopping after this many purchases in one stay.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBell.Desc: Guests may ring a bell for a venue that is closed. Awake colonists with the Serving work type come and open it for a surcharge. Nobody is woken up.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellMin.Desc: A bell service never costs less than this (silver).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellSurcharge.Des: Extra share of the price that guests pay when they ring the bell outside opening hours.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellWaitHours.Des: How long a guest waits after ringing before giving up ('Rang the bell. Nobody came.').
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.priceTolerance.Desc: How much guests put up with. Above 1 they accept steeper prices, below 1 they haggle with their feet. Follows the difficulty slider.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.selfService.Desc: Venues that do not need staff but have nobody behind the counter charge this much less (the guest fetches everything themselves).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.shopDesire.Desc: How eagerly guests walk into shops and taverns compared with other things they could do. 0 = they never shop.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.shopPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of goods sold in shops and taverns, on top of each sign's own price factor.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.stallFee.Desc: Every trader caravan pays this much silver for its stall on market day (it goes into the colony till).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.tendHours.Desc: How long a colonist tends a venue before looking for other work (they also stop when it closes).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.vendingPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of what vending machines sell.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.waitForStaffTicks.Desc: A guest waits this long for somebody to come to an open but unstaffed venue, then gives up annoyed.
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoCounter: No counter (optional) → the tender stands next to the sign
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoDrinks: No drinks in stock → store beer or other drinks in the room
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoStock: No goods for sale → put a shelf or stockpile with goods in the room
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoWorker: Nobody has the Serving work type switched on
keyed.HH.Venue.ChooseTypeDesc: Choose what kind of business the room of this sign is: tavern, shop, restaurant, casino, spa or lounge.
keyed.HH.Venue.ColonyMayTakeDesc: Off: goods for sale in this room are forbidden for your colonists, so nobody carries your stock away. On: colonists treat the goods like any other stored item.
keyed.HH.Venue.HoursDesc: Set when the business is open. Presets for day, evening, night and around the clock.
keyed.HH.Venue.HoursHint: A closing hour earlier than the opening hour means the business stays open past midnight.
keyed.HH.Venue.MarketFees: The traders pay {0} silver for their stalls.
keyed.HH.Venue.MarketText: Word has spread: it is market day. {0} trader caravans and {1} groups of visitors from {2} are on their way to your colony. Traders will trade as usual at their camps; visitors will browse your shops and taverns if they are open.\n\nKeep your shelves stocked and your counters staffed.
keyed.HH.Venue.NoRoom: Not a business yet: the sign needs an enclosed, roofed room.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceDesc: Price factor on everything this business sells. Guests are put off by prices that are too high.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceHint: Guests compare the price with what the item is worth to them. Wealthy guests put up with more. Venues without anybody on duty charge a little less (self-service); a night bell service costs extra. Free means free.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockDesc: Let this sign set the storage places in its room to take your goods with priority Important, so haulers keep the shelves full. Opt-in; old settings come back when you switch it off.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockHint: When on, every storage place in this room (stockpile zones and shelves, yours or anybody's) takes the goods ticked below with priority Important, so your haulers keep the room stocked. The places' old settings come back when you switch this off.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockNoShop: This business does not sell anything from its room, so there is nothing to restock.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockSwitchOff: Restock is ON – switch off and give the storage back

defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSign.label: venue sign
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSign.description: A sign that turns the room it stands in into a business: tavern, shop, restaurant, casino, spa or lounge. Choose the kind of business, opening hours and prices in the sign's controls. Without a sign, a room is just a room.
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSignWall.label: venue sign (wall)
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSignWall.description: The same sign, hung on a wall. The room it faces becomes the business. Choose the kind of business, opening hours and prices in the sign's controls.
defs.ThingDef/HH_ShopCounter.label: shop counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_ShopCounter.description: A counter for a shopkeeper or bartender. Whoever tends the venue stands behind it, and the day's takings are put down as silver here at midnight. A counter is optional: without one, the tender stands next to the sign.
defs.ThingDef/HH_MarketStall.label: market stall
defs.ThingDef/HH_MarketStall.description: A free-standing stall with a striped awning. The big market only takes place once you own enough stalls (see the Venues settings): every trader caravan sets up at one and pays a stall fee into your till. Standing outside, it works in any weather but is not a business of its own.
defs.ThingDef/HH_VendingMachine.label: vending machine
defs.ThingDef/HH_VendingMachine.description: A powered cabinet that holds food, drinks, drugs and medicine. Guests buy from it at any hour without any staff, at market value. Haulers fill it like a shelf. Colonists may help themselves for free; the machine only charges guests. Needs power to sell.
defs.WorkGiverDef/HH_ServeVenue.label: tend venues
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Tavern.desc: A room where guests buy a drink and drink it on the spot. Stock the room with beer or other drinks on a shelf or in a stockpile; a bartender behind the sign or counter keeps it open. Drinks in the room are reserved for customers unless the sign says otherwise.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Shop.label: shop
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Shop.descri: A room where guests buy goods. Everything stored on shelves and in stockpiles inside the room is for sale, at market value times the sign's price factor. Without a shopkeeper the shop runs as self-service at a small discount.
A room where guests sit down and eat. Tables, a kitchen and a waiter make it a restaurant; the dishes themselves are handled by the kitchen.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Casino.desc: A room of card tables, slot machines and croupiers. Guests stake their silver on games of chance; the house keeps a small, honest edge.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Spa.label: spa
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Spa.descrip: A quiet room for baths, steam and rest. An attendant keeps the towels warm; guests pay by the visit.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Lounge.desc: A waiting room with seats. Guests who find a business closed or unstaffed wait here instead of in the doorway, and wait more patiently. Always open, no staff needed.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Chapel.desc: A quiet room with a guest altar where visitors of every faith come to pray. Guests pay nothing but leave calmer; a chapel with a handsome altar and a few pews is a good neighbour for an inn. Always open during the day, no staff needed.
